name: chuqing-note
description: 初晴笔记 (ChuQing Note) - 专为 NAS 与私有云打造的现代化、离线优先富文本笔记系统
author: ChuQing Note

scripts.build:apk: npm run build:web && cd packages/android && npx cap sync android && cd android && export ANDROID_HOME=${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/dev_tools/android-sdk} && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../../web/public/chuqing-note.apk && echo '✅ Android APK compiled successfully!'
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && npm run build:web
